{{Quote|Protas met the vast swarm of kikla in the deepest waters of the Ancient Trench, and there they fought.|Ryan Kaufman, "The Tale of the Aiwha Pod"|<ref name="tale" />}}
According to the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] legend "[[The Tale of the Aiwha Pod]]," the '''Ancient Trench''' was an [[Water/Legends|underwater]] trench located on the<ref name="tale" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Kamino">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] and was the site of a [[Battle of the Ancient Trench|battle]] between the [[Deity/Legends|monster-god]] [[Protas]] and the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[kikla]]. The kikla had assembled an army, and they challenged Protas for rule of the planet's [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]. Protas accepted the challenge, and after a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] of fighting, he defeated the challengers.<ref name="tale" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ancient Trench appeared in the [[2005]] [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] [[List of short stories|short story]] "[[The Tale of the Aiwha Pod (short story)|The Tale of the Aiwha Pod]]," which was written by [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] and published in the ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando: Prima Official Game Guide]]''.<ref name="tale" />
